faq_heading: Homes near Willoughby Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Willoughby Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Willoughby Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Willoughby Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Willoughby Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.6 km west) and Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.8 km north-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Willoughby Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Willoughby Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Maddaugh Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (1.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.6 km west), Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.8 km north-east), Alex Hope Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Josette Dandurand Elementary (1.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 0.5 km south-east of Willoughby Elementary.
